item.title: The week in hip-hop: Gettin' dead fresh with Erykah Badu and Saul Williams
item.description: NPR Music culture critic and reporter Rodney Carmichael ruminates on the latest in rap culture. This week: like-minded releases from Erykah Badu and Saul Williams, closure in the 2Pac murder and more.

item.title: 14 new books in September to help ease you into fall
item.description: Three Pulitzer winners, a Booker Prize winner, two Booker longlisted authors this year, and a number whose works have been adapted for the screen are among the authors with new books out this month.

item.title: Here's how far fans traveled — and what they spent — for Harry Styles' New York City residency
item.description: At a time when both touring costs and concert ticket prices keep climbing, Harry Styles' decision to play a 30-night residency at Madison Square Garden has been met with mixed reactions. NPR talked to fans outside the venue about what it took to attend the residency.

item.title: Whistleblower claims USPS plan for Trump's mail voting order could 'derail' midterms
item.description: A whistleblower says the U.S. Postal Service is rushing out an online system for President Trump's push to restrict mail voting that could "derail" the midterm election if courts allow it to proceed.

item.title: A makeover for college: No gym, no meal plan and two years of work
